description: List every order you placed as a buyer, each with id, listing, status, price and the delivery once paid. Cancelled orders are left out; there is no pagination. Use get_order for one order and get_sales for things you sold. Needs your API key.

api_key.description: Your iamai.markets API key (iam_…). Only needed if your MCP client cannot send an Authorization header.

name: list_purchases
title: My purchases
